summary: Build a professional, premium website for the tailoring business 'Baba Farid Tailor' featuring a catalog, online ordering with customer measurements, and standard business pages (Home, About, Catalog, Order Now, Contact).
architectural_notes: Website should support a user-uploaded custom logo; include a placeholder slot in the header until provided.
Premium visual theme using Charcoal Grey, Gold, and/or Deep Blue across the site.
Information architecture includes pages: Home, About Us, Catalog, Order Now, Contact Us.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Premium fabric texture background, subtle weave pattern, dark charcoal tone (fabric-texture-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Elegant tailoring hero banner with abstract tailoring elements (measuring tape/suit silhouette), charcoal and gold palette (tailoring-hero-banner.dim_2400x900.png)

existing_features.title: Create a multi-page website with the following sections/pages and navigation: Home, About Us, Catalog, Order Now, and Contact Us. Ensure the header navigation links correctly route/scroll to each section and the active section is visually indicated.

Implement a top header area that prominently displays the business name "Baba Farid Tailor" and includes a dedicated logo placeholder region intended for a future uploaded custom logo (placeholder should be visually distinct and sized appropriately).
Display contact details (Mobile Number and Email ID) clearly in a top bar and/or footer, using placeholder values that can be easily replaced later (e.g., constants/config in the frontend).

Create a premium 'Catalog' section that showcases the categories: Suits, Shirts, Pants, and Traditional wear. Each category must have a presentable card/tile layout and a way to choose a style that can be used by the Order Now form.

Implement an 'Order Now' page containing an online order form where customers can (1) select a category and style from the catalog and (2) submit their measurements (including at minimum Length, Chest, Waist, Shoulder). Include additional common tailoring measurements as appropriate and provide size-chart guidance in the UI (e.g., a reference table and/or helper text) without requiring user authentication.
Add an About Us section that explicitly mentions expertise in bespoke tailoring and premium craftsmanship, using clear English copy appropriate for a professional tailoring brand.

Add a Contact Us section/page that includes the displayed phone/email, a simple contact form (name, email/phone, message) and clear location placeholder text. The contact form may submit to the backend as a stored inquiry or may be UI-only if backend storage is not implemented; if backend storage is implemented, it must persist inquiries in the backend actor.

Apply a premium, professional visual theme across the entire site using a coherent palette based on Charcoal Grey with Gold accents and optional Deep Blue highlights. Ensure consistent typography, spacing, button styles, and section hierarchy, and avoid using a blue+purple default theme.
Integrate React Query-based data fetching for catalog and order submission, including loading and error states for: catalog load, order submission, and (if implemented) contact inquiry submission.

Add required generated static images to enhance the premium tailoring aesthetic (e.g., subtle fabric texture and a hero/banner image) and render them from frontend static assets (do not serve images via the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create website header with prominent business name and a dedicated placeholder area for an uploaded custom logo
Display contact details (mobile number and email) clearly in a top bar and/or footer for easy customer reach
Add a Catalog section showcasing categories: Suits, Shirts, Pants, and Traditional wear
Implement an Order Now page with an online order form to select styles from the catalog and submit customer measurements (e.g., length, chest, waist, shoulder) guided by size charts
Apply a premium design aesthetic with a color palette such as Charcoal Grey, Gold, and/or Deep Blue to reflect high-quality craftsmanship
Create required site sections/pages: Home, About Us (bespoke tailoring expertise), Catalog, Order Now (form), and Contact Us

Create a backend data model and API in the single Motoko actor to: (1) return catalog categories/styles, (2) accept new order submissions containing selected catalog style + customer measurements + basic contact info, and (3) list orders for basic verification/testing purposes (non-authenticated is acceptable unless otherwise specified).
